description: This file defines a DownloadController for managing download items, including restoration from persistent storage, enqueueing, removals, pausing, resuming, and simulation of download progress. It also defines data models for download items and statuses.

classes.name: DownloadItem
classes.description: Data model representing an individual download item, including its properties such as id, contentId, title, status, progress, and timestamps.

classes.name: DownloadController
classes.description: Controller class managing download operations, state persistence, and simulation, extending ChangeNotifier for UI updates.

methods.name: restoreFromDisk
methods.description: Restores download queue and item states from the database, and optionally resumes in-progress downloads.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new download to the queue, persists it, and starts the download simulation if queue is not paused.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a download item from the database and cancels its engine process.

methods.name: togglePaused
methods.description: Toggles the global download queue pause state, updating database and managing active downloads accordingly.

methods.name: resumeItem
methods.description: Resumes a paused download item if the queue is not globally paused.

methods.name: _setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status and timestamp of a download item in the database.

methods.name: _upsertProgress
methods.description: Updates the download progress, status, and related data in the database.

methods.name: _startSimulation
methods.description: Starts a simulated download process via the engine, periodically updating progress callbacks.
